definitions.explanation: The line or point that separates two areas or things.

examples.notes: [Note: When used as suffix, read ざかい]

examples.english: The boundary between life and death.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}らの{家|いえ}は{境|さかい}を{接|せっ}しているので、{毎日|まいにち}{顔|かお}を{合|あ}わせる。
examples.english: Their houses share a boundary, so they see each other every day.

notes:
{境|さかい} refers to boundaries.

COMMON USES:
- {県|けん}{境|ざかい} (prefectural border)
- {国|くに}{境|ざかい} (national border)
- {境|さかい}{目|め} (borderline, turning point)
- 〜を{境|さかい}に (from ~ onwards)

NOTE: As a suffix, often read ざかい.

SIMILAR:
- {境|さかい}: boundary (general)
- {境界|きょうかい}: boundary (formal)
- {国境|こっきょう}: national border
